description:
Delete the storage section that re-proves mutation finalization through both backends.

## Background

The typed-mutation-determinism section of `crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs` (`:1754-2585`) re-proves finalization, which the repository-state layer owns as a pure function of the image.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The typed-mutation-determinism section of `repository_state_store_tests.rs` no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: Remaining storage tests assert only what a backend adds to finalization, such as publication, durability or read-back.
title: Storage tests stop re-proving mutation finalization
